_notes: Copy to bots/wrapper/configs/<id>.json in the phase that integrates the bot (docs/FLEET-PLAN.md).
commands: the exact argv for each mode, run from cwd (relative to the repo root). A mode with an empty list is refused.
env: extra variables per mode. Never put keys here: keys go in bots/wrapper/.env, which is gitignored and edited by the owner only.
metricsFile: optional JSON the bot (or a small adapter) writes: {pnlUsd, sends, gasUsd, detail, routes, metrics}. See bots/CONTRACT.md.
live: only used when the owner runs the wrapper with --live and FLEET_LIVE_<ID>=1 is set in bots/wrapper/.env.
